ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Stories of Prophets: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Taqwa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Tawakkul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
